phase_name: Link Registration, the 404/403 Policy, Canonical Write, Role Note

objectives.description: Extract the project.json write into write_link_file(), route create path through it
Bind-mode dry-run posture: print link payload via SAPIENCE_DRY_RUN=1 sapience_post, exit 0
Existing-link guard: refuse a conflicting prior binding unless --force
--project <value> --confirm: POST the link route, branch on HTTP status (2xx/404/403/other)
MUST NOT comment: link response's project field is a descriptor dict, never a cid
Role note from the picked row's owner flag, printed on success and 404 paths
End the reply with the exact file to commit; confirm no git invocation in the bind path
Add test cases 18-21 with a link-route stub branch and call counter

approaches_tried.approach: Call sapience_post via x="$(sapience_post ...)" command substitution in the bind-mode confirm path, then branch on sapience_api_post_http_status
approaches_tried.reason: command substitution forks a subshell; sapience_post's non-local sapience_api_post_http_status assignment never reaches the caller, so the status always read back empty and the case statement always fell through to the default/loud-failure branch regardless of the real HTTP status
